{{Quote|As the saying goes, 'If you can't find something fun to do on Adarlon, you're either dead or an Imperial.'|[[Cohden K'Reye]]|<ref name="WH" />}}
'''Adarlon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. Located on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]<ref name="TEA" />, it attracted many tourists, and was known for its music, schools, theme parks and [[Holodrama/Legends|holographic entertainment]].

==Description==
Adarlon was a rugged, [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] and relatively underpopulated [[Planet/Legends|world]]. Its climate varied considerably by region but was overall considered pleasing by its inhabitants, especially along the west coast of the northen continent and in the [[Forest/Legends|forested]] regions between the mountains and the [[Ocean/Legends|sea]]; inhabited mainly by [[Human/Legends|Humans]], these regions hosted the main three [[City/Legends|cities]] of the planet and featured a temperate climate with high humidity. Thanks to [[Weather control/Legends|climate control]], the cites were always sunny for the majority of the day and it rained exclusively, but reguarly, in the early morning.<ref name="GG6-1" />

==History==
===Early history===
Adarlon was one of the first colonies in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]], being colonized around [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]] by a group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] altruists&mdash;many from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]&mdash; by official decree of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Rupublic Senate]], that selected the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] for its beauty rather than its extremely scarce resources. The young colonists were particularly well-funded, and their society grew into one focused on entertainment rather than survival. It soon became the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]'s entertainment capital and one of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]'s most prominent centers for tourism and the entertainment industry. The [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] industry was pioneered by the planet.<ref name="GG6-1" />

===Imperial Era===
After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] the legitimate entertainment industry of Adarlon, who once supported the values of the Republic with holos displaying great features of honor, courage, justice, freedom and love, soon became a medium for [[Artist/Legends|artists]] to express their adversion to the New Order. [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor Palpatine]] appointed [[Babel Torsch]], at the time chief advisor of the planet's Imperial [[Consul-General|Consular-General]] to solve the issue. Thanks to Torsch, free speech in Adarlon's holodrama indutry was effectively destroyed through a series of crackdowns and blacklisting masked as a way to reduce obscenities in enteirtainment. By 2 BBY, Aderlon's enteirtainment industry was considered to have lost any semblance of artistic integrity in the eyes of many holodrama experts and enthusiasts.<ref name="GG6-1" /> 

Despite the media purge conducted by the Empire, Imperial presence on the planet was limited to the [[Adarlon spaceport|spaceport]], where the Imperial Consulate could be found. Stationed in the Consulate were [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs inspectors]] and 100 [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], which under normal circumstances weren't allowed to patrol or arrest beings outside of the spaceport complex. No one was allowed to enter or leave the planet without the approval of the Consular-General, which was also tasked with collecting taxes from his living quarters in the spaceport.<ref name="GG6-1" />

==Society==
It was on Adarlon that the [[Holodrama/Legends|holographic medium]] was developed as an entertainment staple. Classic holofilms included the stories of the voiceless [[Tito (character)|Tito]] or the refugee [[Ansil]], alongside the adventures of other popular characters such as the [[Tree-ranger|tree-rangers]] of [[Yelsain/Legends|Yelsain]] or the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] of [[Mestra system/Legends|Mestra]]. After [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] for underground holos saw an increase in demand, with groups of rebellious directors such as the [[No-Holds-Barred]] producing illegal holos, somethimes smuggling them off-[[Planet/Legends|planet]].
[[Music/Legends|Music]] from the planet was also highly sophisticated, and it was home to one of the most famous [[Opera/Legends|opera]] companies in the galaxy, and famous opera singer [[Neile Janna]]. [[Comedian|Comedians]], [[Folk music|folk]] musicians, singers and [[Deva/Legends|deva]] bands were all common to find in the [[City/Legends|cities]] of Adarlon, and were all of high quality.
The catering sector was also very prolific, so much that a new [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] was said to open every [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] on the planet.<ref name="GG6-1" />
Tourism was the main industry of the world, with new attractions and activities being organized every year. As of [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], iceberg climbing and live-action roleplaying [[Amusement park|theme parks]] were extremely popular with both natives and tourists, both being considered a very expensive activity by average standards.<ref name="GG6-1" />
